title: Result Record v0
$comment: AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY (DevSpec Section 34). One record per fixture x lane execution. status distinguishes UNSUPPORTED / BLOCKED / FAIL_INVARIANT / ERROR_RUNTIME because they carry different architectural meaning: unsupported != failed. usage is provenance-aware and nullable: missing usage != zero usage.

observed_terminal_state.$comment: P0.6C additive. The provider/framework-native terminal signal, made queryable at the result level instead of only inside the transcript. result.status is the AUDIT verdict; this is the RUNTIME terminal state, a different axis. native preserves the raw terminal string; category is a coarse audit bucket; unknown natives are kept verbatim, never dropped.

usage.$comment: DevSpec Section 32. All token fields nullable; missing usage stays null, never 0. finality=partial when cancelled mid-stream. P0.6C: cache_read/cache_creation added so Anthropic's two-field cache split (and any provider's cache reads) survive into the summary instead of collapsing into a single OpenAI-shaped cached_input_tokens; reasoning_tokens carries Gemini thought tokens (normalization, documented in the gemini normalizer). `source` (P0.6C additive) answers 'reported by WHOM' — provenance answers 'reported vs estimated vs absent' — so framework-normalized usage is no longer indistinguishable from provider-native usage.

cached_input_tokens.$comment: Back-compat: equals cache_read_input_tokens. Retained so existing readers keep working.

source.$comment: Usage-token provenance vocabulary (harness/audit-scoped, see harness provenance module). provider_native = provider's own usage block; framework_native = a framework's normalized usage (e.g. LangChain usage_metadata); local_estimate = harness-computed; unavailable = no usage reported.
